name: destatis_search
description: Search Germany's official federal statistics (Destatis, the Statistisches Bundesamt; GENESIS) for data tables by keyword, in English or German (amtliche Statistik) — population (Bevölkerung), births (Geburten), GDP (Bruttoinlandsprodukt), inflation/CPI, employment (Erwerbstätige), foreign trade, production, and turnover (Umsatz) by industry such as lotteries and betting (Lotteriewesen). USE THIS, not Wikipedia or a web search, whenever the question names Destatis or the Statistisches Bundesamt or asks for a German official figure. Common topics (lotteries and betting, insolvencies, population, births, deaths, employment, prices, GDP, trade, production, retail, tourism, earnings) are answered instantly from a curated table index with a data_as_of date; other terms go to a live title search, which is slow for full sentences, so pass key words. Returns matching table codes (e.g. "12411-0001") + titles; pass a code to destatis_table to get the data.

term.description: Keyword(s) in English or German, e.g. "population", "Bevölkerung", "consumer prices", "Umsatz". English is tried first, then German.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own free Destatis GENESIS API token. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx token.

name: destatis_table
description: Fetch a Destatis GENESIS statistical table's data by its code (get codes from destatis_search), e.g. "12411-0001" (population) or "61111-0001" (consumer price index). Returns the table content (values across its dimensions) plus title. Germany-wide and by Land where the table provides it. A table can offer only a coarse level (e.g. 48112-0001 is WZ sections A-S only; the 4-digit industry rows are in the sibling 48112-0002): call with structure:true to see its dimensions, then filter with classifying_key1 (e.g. WZ08-9200 for gambling and betting) and start_year/end_year. A filtered call takes 12-20s.

structure.description: true = return the table's dimensions (variables, time range, classification levels) instead of data. Use it to learn which classification keys a table offers before filtering.

classifying_key1.description: Filter the table's 1st classifying variable to these keys (comma-separated, e.g. "WZ08-92" for lotteries/betting in an industry table). Without a filter GENESIS may return only the top level (e.g. WZ sections).

classifying_variable1.description: Name of the 1st classifying variable (from structure:true), e.g. "WZ08". Optional.

classifying_variable2.description: Name of the 2nd classifying variable. Optional.

classifying_variable3.description: Name of the 3rd classifying variable. Optional.

area.description: GENESIS area: free (default), public, all, user.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own free Destatis GENESIS API token. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx token.
